summary: First-iteration full test of CottonHub MVP. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases passed (auth, listings CRUD, filters, conversations, messages, AI assist via GPT-5.2, WebSocket auth + reject). Frontend: landing/login/marketplace/listing detail/CRC/dashboard/create-listing pages all load. Contact Seller → Spark AI flow could not be fully verified via playwright due to selector ambiguity but backend endpoints back it successfully.

integration_issues.issue: Automated selector for 'Contact Seller' button + chat start flow not conclusively traversed by playwright; manual visual check of /listings/:id shows the button exists. Add data-testid='contact-seller-btn' and data-testid='send-message-btn' to stabilize tests.

Could not verify textarea population because the Contact->Chat navigation did not complete during automation. Backend AI /api/ai/assist works (verified by pytest). Add data-testid='spark-ai-btn' and data-testid='chat-input'.

issues: Only 1 listing card link detected via a[href*='/listings/'] on /marketplace; backend returns 4 listings. Verify cards render as links for all listings, or add data-testid='listing-card' to each card.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to key interactive elements: listing-card, contact-seller-btn, send-message-btn, spark-ai-btn, chat-input, login-email, login-password, login-submit, register-submit, create-listing-submit
Verify marketplace renders all 4 seeded listings as clickable cards (linking to /listings/:id) — current UI exposed only 1 link to the automation
No business-logic fixes required; backend is solid
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 680 lines — still manageable but approaching split threshold; consider modules for auth/listings/conversations/ai.
AI assist does not validate payload.mode against allowed values (silently falls back) — acceptable but a 400 for invalid mode would be cleaner.
WebSocket rooms use asyncio.Lock with a list; for scale consider a set and per-room locks, but OK for MVP.
JWT 30-day expiry is long for B2B; consider refresh tokens post-MVP.
No rate-limit on /api/ai/assist — potential cost leak; add simple per-user throttling.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (pages load + core nav works; chat end-to-end not fully verified through UI)

test_credentials: demo@cottonhub.com / demo1234 (buyer), sara@greenfield.in / demo1234 (seller), marco@textilemill.it / demo1234 — confirmed working
seed_data_creation: No new seed — relied on auto-seeded 3 users + 4 listings from backend startup. Tests created 'TEST_' prefixed listings/users which are isolated and non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green (see /app/backend/tests/test_cottonhub.py). For full UI e2e of Contact→Chat→Spark flow, data-testids need to be added; once added, a single playwright pass can cover: login → marketplace → click listing-card → contact-seller-btn → fill chat-input → send-message-btn → spark-ai-btn → assert textarea populated. AI calls take 4-8s; sleep accordingly.
